preserve: Natural sky, cloud, sea and mountain scenery
Original records, versions, sources, privacy and confirmation boundaries
supersedesVisualOnly: The continuous-white description in design/tokens.json is the legacy native baseline. Original design documents remain unchanged. This specification does not change product processing, storage or authorization rules.

implementationMap.strategy: G2 introduces theme-scoped semantic colors and surfaces. Do not manually edit generated legacy tokens or globally rename every business call site. Migrate one connected route at a time; leave legacy compatibility available until parity is proven.
implementationMap.preferencesMigration: Add theme and background mode to versioned non-sensitive display preferences; preserve existing v1-v4 reads, companion, reduceMotion, recap and capture policy. Unknown/corrupt data must not broaden processing. Theme write failure must remain visible. No record text or credentials enter this file.

geometryRules: Values are starting points, not fixed text-container heights
Task rows grow with title and reminder state
Record editor grows with content and available IME-safe height
Task editor starts compact; date follows title
Long content scrolls inside an owned route without losing navigation context
At 2x fonts reflow controls instead of scaling the whole phone

typography.family: Android system sans serif; no downloaded font

colorEncoding: Hex uses RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA (CSS alpha last); explicitly convert to Compose ARGB. Candidates require composed-pixel checks before native acceptance.

surfacePolicy.welcome: Most translucent; no heavy shadow; backdrop text must remain readable. Strengthen local scrim when needed.
surfacePolicy.reading: Stable low-frequency gradient fill; sharp text above scenery; no moving highlight crossing glyphs.
surfacePolicy.input: Opaque theme-colored fill for sustained editing and error feedback.
surfacePolicy.sheet: Opaque theme-colored fill; only underlying content is dimmed; keyboard never blurs.
surfacePolicy.navigation: Stable theme fill plus safe system inset; labels always visible.
surfacePolicy.api26to30: Shared scenery plus tinted gradient surfaces; no runtime blur required; retain theme rather than white fallback.
surfacePolicy.api31plus: Use the same reliable baseline initially. Any optional blur applies to an isolated background image layer, never the composited text/control tree; profiling is required before enabling expensive sampling.
surfacePolicy.sceneryFailure: Theme-colored low-frequency gradient with readable foreground; recording remains usable.

completion.normal: Primary fill and onPrimary text; one per panel
completion.busy: Preserve label/context, disable repeat submission, announce saving
completion.failure: Keep input and offer retry; no success toast
completion.disabled: Noninteractive semantics, not merely reduced alpha

tool.normal: Unfilled icon; 48dp target; photos and audio adjacent
tool.pressed: Small tint response without moving neighbors
tool.label: Accessible action name; no redundant visible helper text

filter.normal: Media type and favorites are separate dimensions
filter.selected: Label plus selected semantics; do not rely on color alone
filter.apply: Only Apply commits draft filters; Reset does not erase search

task.busy: Do not hide task before repository acknowledgement
task.complete: Stable completed state only after successful mutation
task.failure: Restore or retain prior state and explain failure
task.reminder: Scheduled, restricted, failed and unscheduled remain distinct

audio.normal: Actual duration and position from playback state
audio.unavailable: No enabled play action for missing/corrupt source
audio.waveform: Use real measured data or honest progress bar; no fabricated wave evidence

navigation.selected: Small selection container plus label and selected semantics
navigation.repeat: Latest selection wins; no queued page animations

companion.fallback: Neutral slot or approved static asset only
companion.trigger: Explicit tap or actual save success
companion.data: No record reading or task creation

motion.actualPlayback: Resume only when foreground, route eligible, no editing/scrolling and neither app nor system reduces motion. Preserve selected preference when paused.
motion.interruption: Retarget current animation; do not queue transitions or delay business actions.
motion.reduced: No continuous background animation, spatial slide or bounce; immediate state or brief non-spatial fade.
motion.performance: No repeated whole-screen blur per card; no animation-driven database writes; actual 60/120Hz device evidence remains required.

verification.contrast: Measure final composited pixels for text >=4.5:1 and essential controls/state >=3:1, separately from decorative borders. Check scenery extremes, sheet, pressed/selected and low-API fallback. Alpha candidates are not pre-certified.
verification.riskCombination: 320dp + 2x fonts + long Chinese text; all themes for core routes; do not claim all Cartesian combinations without executing them.
verification.nativeEvidence: Candidate APK hash, API, viewport/fontScale, scenario and screenshot per check; browser captures are design references only.
